title: Overlap-ADAPT-VQE: Practical Quantum Chemistry on Quantum Computers via Overlap-Guided Compact Ansatze
problem_summary: Grows the ADAPT-VQE ansatz by maximizing overlap with an intermediate target wavefunction that already captures some electronic correlation (rather than the standard energy-gradient selection criterion alone), producing ultra-compact ansatze -- reported especially advantageous, with large circuit-depth savings, for strongly correlated systems.

components.family_or_name: overlap-guided operator selection (vs. standard energy-gradient selection)
components.notes: Selection criterion maximizes overlap with an intermediate correlated target wavefunction.

workflow_composition_notes: Same adaptive-growth VQE loop as ADAPT-VQE, with the operator-selection criterion replaced by overlap-maximization against a target correlated wavefunction rather than pure energy-gradient magnitude.
